title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
summary: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.
body: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.
summaryZh: OpenAI官方发布声明，宣布由于Cursor被SpaceX收购，决定逐步终止向其提供OpenAI模型支持的合同。这一业务调整反映了大模型厂商在面对客户所有权变更时的战略收缩与合规考量，对AI开发工具生态和模型调用合作模式产生了直接冲击，引发业界对大模型商业边界与数据安全的新一轮讨论。
